description: Stožáry veřejného osvětlení is a dataset listed in Czech National Open Data Portal, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Statutární město Brno. English description below. Point layer of all public lighting masts in Brno. The data come from the Technical Network Brno and are updated on a semi-annual basis (March and September). The coordinate system is GCS WGS84. Point layer of all street lighting poles in Brno. Source of the data is Technical Networks Brno company. Coverage: Statutární město Brno. The portal shows the English title as "Street lights" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Statutární město Brno. Its keywords include street lights, sloupy, technické sítě, lights, lamps, ODAE. The listing shows 5 download or service links in GEOJSON, CSV, JSON, ZIP. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://data.gov.cz/zdroj/datové-sady/44992785/f3a3e419a7d4af3123ecee9eb7aa404b/distribuce/a14afc0b7483b8e3422c9e6f9aaeb86e/podmínky-užití). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support telecommunication coverage and network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-nkod-opendata-cz.
